verdict.rationale: Smooth's own API runs AI browser tasks autonomously on its cloud. A single run call starts a task, which you track by polling, list, or cancel, and you can watch it via a live URL. Persistent profiles let tasks reuse logins without supervision. However, there is no documented way to set up standing automations that trigger or recur on their own: monitoring is described as 'on demand', and any recurrence would rely on external tooling the user supplies. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling or recurring automations, event triggers, an automation-management UI or definitions, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.
